supplements.title: Integrating GC-MS analysis, ADMET, and in vivo experimental validation to deciphering the toxicological profile of the aqueous extract of the mixture of Dacryodes edulis (G. Don) H.J. Lam (Burseraceae) and Allium ampeloprasum var. porrum L. (Amaryllidaceae).
supplements.summary: Researchers tested the safety of a traditional plant mixture used to treat prostate cancer in Cameroon through laboratory and animal studies.

supplements.title: Guhan Yangsheng Jing alleviates sleep deprivation-induced neuronal injury via neurotransmitter rebalancing, mitochondrial protection, and inhibition of pyroptosis.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese herbal medicine called Guhan Yangsheng Jing protects brain cells from sleep deprivation damage through multiple protective mechanisms.

supplements.title: Triterpenoid saponins from Platycodon grandiflorus exhibit antidepressant-like effects and are associated with BDNF-mediated neuroplasticity signaling in a chronic stress model.
supplements.summary: Plant compounds from Platycodon grandiflorus reduce depression-like symptoms by activating brain growth signaling in stressed mice.

supplements.title: Progress in research on the hepatoprotective effects of C-21 steroidal glycosides from Baishouwu.
supplements.summary: Researchers studied how compounds from Baishouwu, a traditional Chinese herb, may protect liver health and combat aging.

supplements.title: Alleviation of adverse effects associated with α-glucosidase inhibitors by Ocimum basilicum L., Matricaria chamomilla L., and Salvia officinalis L. reveals novel selective inhibition of Bacillus α-glucosidase by acarbose.
supplements.summary: Acarbose selectively inhibits gut bacterial enzymes rather than causing excess fermentation, suggesting diabetes medication side effects stem from microbiome disruption instead.

supplements.title: The Central Qi theory in traditional Chinese medicine: Gut microbiota modulation as a strategic target for hepatocellular carcinoma therapy.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese herbal medicine may improve quality of life and treatment tolerance in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma patients by modulating gut bacteria.

supplements.title: Enhancement of wound healing in patients with Hansen's disease: The effects of Jinchuang ointment on anti-inflammation and cell migration.
supplements.summary: Jinchuang ointment, a traditional Chinese herbal treatment, helps heal chronic wounds in Hansen's disease patients by reducing inflammation and promoting cell migration.

supplements.title: Mechanic exploration of Yin Jia tablet against chronic salpingitis via the miR-34a-5p-mediated ceRNA network.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified how a traditional Chinese medicine tablet treats chronic salpingitis through a specific molecular pathway involving microRNA regulation.

supplements.title: Sishen Wan suppresses colon cancer through dual inhibition of PI3K/AKT/mTOR and STAT3-mitophagy pathways: Network pharmacology and experimental validation.
supplements.summary: Sishen Wan, a traditional Chinese medicine, fights colon cancer by blocking two key cell growth pathways and damaging cancer cell power plants.

supplements.title: Mechanism of Astragali radix combined with Salviae miltiorrhizae Radix et Rhizoma in alleviating diabetic nephropathy: Focus on the AGEs/RAGE/MAPK signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Two traditional Chinese herbs combined reduce diabetic kidney disease by blocking harmful protein damage pathways.

supplements.title: Mai-Men-Dong decoction alleviates radiation-induced lung injury by regulating ferroptosis through modulation of the STAT6/p53/SLC7A11 axis.
supplements.summary: Mai-Men-Dong decoction, a traditional Chinese medicine, protects lungs from radiation damage by preventing harmful cell death through specific molecular pathways.

supplements.title: Integration of multi-omics and machine learning to identify core genes in PANoptosisof lung adenocarcinoma and their mechanisms in the tumor microenvironment and therapeutic potential.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified six key genes controlling a novel cell death pathway in lung adenocarcinoma and showed ginsenosides can activate this pathway to kill cancer cells.

supplements.title: Design and synthesis of novel triazole-metronidazole boswellic acid hybrids for ovarian cancer targeting.
supplements.summary: Researchers created new hybrid compounds targeting ovarian cancer cells while sparing healthy cells, with compound 21 showing the most promise.

supplements.title: Astragaloside IV targets TUBB4B to inhibit proliferation and promote apoptosis of pituitary tumor cells via the STMN1/ERK pathway.
supplements.summary: Astragaloside IV, a compound from traditional Chinese medicine, stops pituitary tumor growth by targeting a protein called TUBB4B.

supplements.title: Combining bioinformatics prediction with experimental validation to explore the ameliorative effect of Psoralea corylifolia on vitiligo.
supplements.summary: Psoralea corylifolia plant extracts increase melanin production in vitiligo through multiple active ingredients targeting apoptosis and PI3K/Akt pathways.

off_label.title: Entrectinib attenuates LPS-induced neuroinflammation by inhibiting JNK, p38, and AKT pathways and ameliorates cognitive impairment.
off_label.summary: Entrectinib, a lung cancer drug, reduces brain inflammation and improves memory by blocking specific inflammatory pathways in mice.

off_label.title: Synthesis of potent human DHRS11 inhibitors and their efficacy against androgen-dependent proliferation and sensitivity to AKT inhibitor Capivasertib of triple-negative breast cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed WH23, a potent drug that blocks androgen signaling in triple-negative breast cancer and overcomes resistance to AKT inhibitor treatment.

off_label.title: Deciphering functional intra-tumoral heterogeneity in BRAFV600E-driven mouse thyroid cancer reveals EMT trajectory and metabolic remodeling.
off_label.summary: Thyroid cancer cells progress through distinct mesenchymal states; metformin reduces the most aggressive subpopulation and blocks this progression.

off_label.title: Everolimus destabilizes thymidylate synthase via suppressing its O-GlcNAcylation and sensitizes HER2-negative breast cancer to fluorouracil.
off_label.summary: Everolimus enhances fluorouracil effectiveness in HER2-negative breast cancer by destabilizing a key drug target protein.

off_label.title: Nationwide survey of ruxolitinib administration for Japanese children with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.
off_label.summary: Ruxolitinib showed high response rates in Japanese children with treatment-resistant hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, offering a promising new therapy option.

off_label.title: Atorvastatin-Driven Methuosis in Glioblastoma: A Biomimetic Nanodrug for Targeted Tumor Therapy.
off_label.summary: Atorvastatin nanoparticles designed to cross the brain-blood barrier effectively kill glioblastoma cells and boost immune response.

off_label.title: Systemic glucocorticoid use and risk of site-specific cancers: a methodological systematic review of observational studies.
off_label.summary: Observational studies on glucocorticoids and cancer risk have significant methodological flaws, with inconsistent findings except for possible non-Hodgkin lymphoma associations.

off_label.title: Glucocorticoid-Induced Proteome and Phosphoproteome Changes in Breast Cancer Cell Lines.
off_label.summary: Dexamethasone, a steroid given with breast cancer chemotherapy, alters proteins that promote cell migration and metastasis through glucocorticoid receptor signaling.

off_label.title: Thoracic endometriosis in an inoperable patient.
off_label.summary: Woman with lung endometriosis treated with hormone therapy when surgery wasn't possible; condition remained stable with complications.

off_label.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists and immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy: a narrative review on mechanistic and clinical evidence.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 drugs may enhance cancer immunotherapy effectiveness by reprogramming the immune system, showing improved survival in multiple cancer types.

off_label.title: Statin Therapy to Reduce Disease Progression From Liver Cirrhosis to Cancer
off_label.summary: Simvastatin may prevent liver cancer development in cirrhosis patients by blocking enzymes that promote cancer cell growth.

off_label.title: GCL-MSE: Graph Contrastive Learning with Mutual Similarity Enhancement for Drug Repositioning.
off_label.summary: A new AI method identifies existing drugs for cancer and other diseases by analyzing drug and disease relationships, predicting treatments like hydroxyurea for breast cancer.

off_label.title: Statins and postmenopausal breast cancer risk; results from the KARMA cohort.
off_label.summary: Statin use in postmenopausal women showed no significant protective effect against breast cancer in a Swedish study.

off_label.title: Safety concerns associated with various types of statins: a disproportionality analysis of the FAERS database.
off_label.summary: Researchers analyzed statin side effects to compare safety profiles across different types and improve patient treatment decisions.

off_label.title: Statins targeting mevalonate-geranylgeranyl diphosphate pathway inhibit proliferation in NK/T lymphoma by promoting pyroptosis.
off_label.summary: Statins kill NK/T cell lymphoma cancer cells by triggering pyroptosis, a type of inflammatory cell death, offering a potential new treatment approach.

biomarkers.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of tepotinib vs capmatinib as subsequent therapy in MET exon 14-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Tepotinib proves more cost-effective than capmatinib for treating advanced lung cancer with specific MET mutations in China.

biomarkers.title: T cell fate regulation in EBV‑associated nasopharyngeal carcinoma (Review).
biomarkers.summary: T cells become exhausted in nasopharyngeal carcinoma, helping the virus-linked cancer evade immune attack and suggesting new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: The heart of the matter: a personal view of Fred Wittinghofer's contributions to RAS biology and drug design.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered how RAS proteins work, enabling development of drugs to treat RAS-driven cancers by blocking cancer cell growth signals.

biomarkers.title: A PI3Kδ-Foxo1-FasL signaling amplification loop rewires CD4+ T cell signaling and differentiation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered that blocking a death pathway protein (FasL) restores normal immune cell development disrupted by PI3K mutations.

biomarkers.title: NMDA-receptor blockade changed microRNAs expression and apoptotic gene levels in dorsolateral striatal glioblastoma to reduce tumor growth and reverse behavioral impairments in rats.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking NMDA receptors in glioblastoma shrinks tumors and restores normal behavior by increasing cancer cell death genes.

biomarkers.summary: Condensin II and cohesin proteins work together to organize chromosomes within cell nuclei, both establishing and maintaining their proper structure throughout the cell cycle.

trials.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of tepotinib vs capmatinib as subsequent therapy in MET exon 14-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer.
trials.summary: Tepotinib proves more cost-effective than capmatinib for treating advanced lung cancer with specific MET mutations in China.

trials.title: Methotrexate-Induced Encephalopathy Mimicking Acute Ischemic Stroke in an Adolescent With Osteosarcoma: A Case Report.
trials.summary: High-dose methotrexate caused brain inflammation in an osteosarcoma patient that mimicked stroke but resolved completely with supportive care alone.

trials.title: [Quality of life measurement in breast cancer patients].
trials.summary: Breast cancer quality of life measurements using validated questionnaires predict patient survival and guide comprehensive treatment evaluation beyond traditional endpoints.

trials.title: Contrasting responses to neoadjuvant immunotherapy in synchronous transverse colon cancers with discordant mismatch repair status.
trials.summary: Colon cancer tumors with mismatch repair deficiency responded completely to immunotherapy, while proficient tumors resisted it, even in the same patient.

trials.title: Regenerative effects of myogenic gene transfected MSC derived exosomes on radiation esophagitis.
trials.summary: Modified stem cell particles containing muscle-building genes successfully regenerated damaged esophageal tissue caused by radiation therapy in mice.

trials.title: Isthmic papillary thyroid microcarcinoma: clinicopathological features and prognostic factors following isthmusectomy based on tumor size stratification.
trials.summary: Thyroid microcarcinoma tumors larger than 5mm show higher recurrence risk after surgery compared to smaller tumors.

trials.title: Radiopharmaceutical Therapy in Oncology: Perspectives from Transatlantic Experts.
trials.summary: Radioactive drugs targeting cancer cell markers show promise for treating prostate cancer and other tumors more effectively and safely.

trials.title: Integrative multi-omics identifies a diagnostic T cell signature for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
trials.summary: Researchers identified three genes (APOE, CYBA, S100A2) that accurately diagnose cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma and reveal its immune characteristics.

trials.title: Pancreas, Muscle, and Subcutaneous Fat Atrophy in Patients Undergoing Radiation for Neuroblastoma.
trials.summary: Radiation therapy for childhood neuroblastoma shrinks the pancreas and reduces muscle and fat in nearby tissues.

trials.title: Challenges in Launching a Precision Pediatric Oncology Program in Argentina.
trials.summary: Argentina's COPPA Project enables free genomic sequencing for childhood cancers to improve diagnosis and treatment selection through expert review teams.

trials.title: Targeting signaling pathways in lymphoma: From molecular mechanisms to clinical breakthroughs.
trials.summary: Targeting specific cell survival pathways with precision medicines offers lymphoma patients chemotherapy-free treatments with better outcomes and fewer side effects.

trials.title: Epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer in the past 30 years (1997-2026).
trials.summary: EGFR inhibitor drugs have evolved significantly over 30 years, becoming the primary treatment for non-small cell lung cancer with improved survival and quality of life.

trials.title: CEST-MRI assessment of locally advanced pMMR rectal cancer for prediction of immune activation status following radiotherapy.
trials.summary: A new MRI scan may predict which rectal cancer patients will respond well to immunotherapy after radiation treatment.

trials.title: TCF3::HLF-positive B-ALL: integrated clinical and molecular characterization of 34 cases from a single-center cohort.
trials.summary: Researchers studied 34 rare, aggressive B-cell leukemia cases to better understand their clinical features and improve patient outcomes.

trials.title: Value of whole-body diffusion-weighted MRI for the prediction of surgical and clinical outcome after neoadjuvant chemotherapy in advanced ovarian cancer.
trials.summary: Whole-body MRI scans after chemotherapy can predict surgical success and survival outcomes in advanced ovarian cancer patients.

mind_body.title: The Central Qi theory in traditional Chinese medicine: Gut microbiota modulation as a strategic target for hepatocellular carcinoma therapy.
mind_body.summary: Traditional Chinese herbal medicine may improve quality of life and treatment tolerance in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma patients by modulating gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of mindfulness-based stress reduction in managing fatigue, anxiety, and depression among non-small cell lung cancer patients receiving surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy: A randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based stress reduction helped reduce fatigue, anxiety, and depression in lung cancer patients undergoing surgery and chemotherapy.

mind_body.title: Prevalence and severity of imposter phenomenon in consultant radiographers.
mind_body.summary: Study finds self-doubt feelings are common among consultant radiographers despite their proven competence and expertise.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture improves cognitive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms in breast cancer survivors: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture treatment improved cognitive function and mental health symptoms in breast cancer survivors in a pilot study.

mind_body.title: Supportive Care Interventions in Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Supportive care interventions like exercise, music, and stress management show promise for improving quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: The Effect of Yoga and Relaxation Techniques on Anxiety, Stress Levels, and Quality of Life in Parents of Children Diagnosed with Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Yoga and relaxation techniques significantly improve anxiety, stress, and quality of life in parents caring for children with cancer.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Acupuncture for Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may help improve thinking and memory problems caused by cancer and its treatments, though more rigorous research is needed.

mind_body.title: Music therapy interventions on symptom management in adults with advanced cancer - multisession longitudinal impact: systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy sessions may help reduce symptoms and improve quality of life in adults with advanced cancer receiving end-of-life care.

mind_body.title: Consensus Recommendations for Disease- and Treatment-Related Fatigue in Patients With Advanced Prostate Cancer: A Modified Delphi Panel.
mind_body.summary: Experts created guidelines to help doctors and advanced prostate cancer patients manage fatigue together through shared decision-making.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture Enhances Effectiveness of Omeprazole in Indomethacin-Induced Gastric Injury Mice via Nrf2 Activation and Vagus Nerve Conduction.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture combined with omeprazole more effectively heals drug-induced stomach damage in mice than omeprazole alone.

mind_body.title: Application of Affective Touch in Patients With Advanced Cancer: Effects on Existential Distress, Pain, and Quality of Life.
mind_body.summary: Affective touch, a gentle hands-on therapy, reduced existential distress, pain, and improved quality of life in advanced cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Art Therapy for Oncology Nurses: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based art therapy reduces psychological stress in oncology nurses, improving their wellbeing and patient care quality.

mind_body.title: Acupoint catgut embedding ameliorates laparotomy-induced cognitive decline in aged mice by restoring gut microbiota.
mind_body.summary: Acupoint catgut embedding treatment reduced post-surgery cognitive decline in elderly mice by restoring healthy gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effects of manual acupuncture on microglial polarization and the Sirt1/NF-κB pathway in a rat model of post-stroke depression.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may treat post-stroke depression by reducing brain inflammation through immune cell regulation.

mind_body.title: Optimizing Postoperative Analgesia After Perianal Abscess Surgery Using Ultrasound-Guided Pudendal Nerve Block Combined with Wrist-Ankle Acupuncture: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Ultrasound-guided nerve blocks combined with acupuncture effectively reduced pain after perianal abscess surgery compared to standard treatment alone.
